arguments.value: Robert F. Rossiter Jr. was born in 1956 in Camp Lejeune, North Carolina. He earned a B.S. from Purdue University in 1978 and a J.D. from Creighton University School of Law in 1981. He clerked for Judge Albert G. Schatz of the U.S. District Court for the District of Nebraska from 1981 to 1982 and for Judge C. Arlen Beam of the same court from 1982 to 1983. He was an adjunct faculty member at Creighton University School of Law from 1983 to 1987 and again from 1999 onward, and he practiced privately in Omaha, Nebraska, from 1983 to 2016. He serves as a judge on the U.S. District Court for the District of Nebraska.
